facts.statement: The maximum exposure to credit risk was H 6,529.57 Crores as at 31st March, 2026.
facts.quote: The maximum exposure to credit risk was H 6,529.57 Crores and H 6,508.78 Crores, as at 31st March, 2026 and 31st March, 2025 respectively, being the total carrying value of trade receivables, investments in debt securities, loans, derivative assets and other financial assets.

facts.statement: Investments in mutual funds amount to H 7,679.42 Crores as at 31st March, 2026.
facts.quote: At 31st March, 2026, the investments in mutual funds amounts to H 7,679.42 Crores (31st March, 2025: H 7,293.23 Crores).

facts.statement: The value of investments in equity instruments measured at fair value through Other Comprehensive Income is H 432.24 Crores as at 31st March, 2026.
facts.quote: The value of investments in such equity instruments as at 31st March, 2026 is H 432.24 Crores (31st March, 2025: H 499.07 Crores).
